The camera wearer is at a street corner beside a crosswalk. A masked pedestrian with a backpack is within arm’s reach, moving from directly ahead toward the right and facing across the intersection; another person briefly appears very close at the lower left. Cars are passing only a few metres away, but nobody is clearly blocking the wearer’s path. No map, tour guide, or identifiable team assembly is visible. The safest appropriate next action is therefore to monitor both pedestrian and vehicle traffic before crossing.
